steps.js: const g=__dmh,P=g.player,V=P.pos.constructor; const holes=[]; let n=0; for(let z=-10500;z<=10500;z+=50){ for(let x=-10500;x<=10500;x+=50){ const [cx,cy]=g.cellOf(x,z); if(!g.navFree(cx,cy)) continue; n++; const h=g.phys.raycastDown(new V(x,140,z),2600,true); if(!h || h.point.y < -40) holes.push([x,z,h?Math.round(h.point.y):null]); } } const b={}; for(const [x,z,y] of holes){ const k=Math.round(x/500)*500+','+Math.round(z/500)*500; (b[k]=b[k]||[]).push(y); } 'checked '+n+' holes '+holes.length+' :: '+Object.entries(b).slice(0,40).map(([k,v])=>k+' x'+v.length+' y'+v[0]).join(' | ')
